svg.title: Two frames from demos/epa: the polytope after two expansions and after it has converged.
svg.desc: Left frame: two wireframe crates overlapping, with a green ghost still inside the blue crate, and on the right panel a small gold bipyramid inside the difference set's grey outline with a short pink vector from the origin. Right frame, the same pair converged: the ghost is clear of the blue crate and the gold polytope now fills most of the difference set.
svg.text: The polytope growing until it presses against a wall you cannot see.
B moved by the current answer — still overlapping on the left
the vector to its closest face: the lower bound
Preset 3, two crates standing on the same floor. The left panel draws a GHOST of the second crate where the current answer would put it, which
is what an unconverged lower bound looks like: a shape that has not quite come free. Press [S] and the pink vector LENGTHENS — the opposite of
GJK's `v`, which only ever shrank. Press [F] to drop the flood fill and watch the depth go wrong.
